tab.label: Datasets
tab.title: Datasets
tab.description: Frozen, citable copies of this experiment's data. The experiment itself stays editable.

failedAt.verify_one: Checking the files failed after {{count}} try
failedAt.verify_other: Checking the files failed after {{count}} tries

zenodoCopy.requestPrepared: Zenodo's copy: request prepared, not yet removed

list.empty: A dataset is a frozen, citable copy of this experiment's data. Publishing one leaves the experiment itself editable.

withdraw.title: Withdraw version {{version}}
withdraw.description: Withdraw a dataset only when it must not stay public, for example because it holds data it should not. This cannot be undone.

consequences.files: openJII stops serving its files to everyone, signed in or not.
consequences.tombstone: Its page becomes a tombstone that keeps the title, authors and DOI and shows your reason.
consequences.zenodo: openJII prepares a withdrawal request to Zenodo with the same reason. Zenodo's copy stays public until Zenodo acts on it.
consequences.doi: The DOI {{doi}} keeps resolving to Zenodo's record.

withdraw.reasonPublic: This reason is public. It shows on the dataset's page and in the request to Zenodo.

scope.title: What this dataset will hold
scope.description: The whole experiment is in scope. A copy is made in the last step, Freeze, and readings added after that are not in it.
scope.readingsDetail_one: Every reading in the experiment, {{count}} so far, minus those you exclude in Curate
scope.readingsDetail_other: Every reading in the experiment, {{count}} so far, minus those you exclude in Curate
scope.dictionaryDetail: Every column the experiment produced, with its description
scope.layoutDetail: The plots and where they sit
scope.studyDetailsDetail: Dates, organism, design, facility and license
scope.firstVersionDetail: This dataset becomes version 1 of the experiment.
scope.versionDetail: Version {{previous}} held {{previousCount}} readings, so this version adds {{added}} so far. Version {{previous}} stays as it was published.
scope.publicExperimentNote: Making the experiment public in its settings is separate. That opens the live experiment to signed-in researchers, while a dataset is a frozen copy anyone can open.

curate.title: Flagged readings
curate.description: Readings flagged on the Data tab or in the app. An excluded reading is left out of the dataset's files and stays in the experiment. The dataset page says how many were left out, never which.
curate.viewReading: Open the reading on {{plot}} on the Data tab
curate.excludedCount_one: {{count}} reading will be left out of the dataset.
curate.excludedCount_other: {{count}} readings will be left out of the dataset.
curate.none: No readings are flagged, so the dataset holds every reading.
curate.loadError: Could not load the flagged readings.

plotChecks.measuredTwiceDescription: More than one reading landed on these plots without a repeat being asked for. Freeze waits until each is resolved, whatever the experiment follows.
plotChecks.skippedDescription: Skipped and not measured again that day. They never hold Freeze, and they start the limitations statement in Describe.
plotChecks.none: No plot was measured twice or left skipped.
plotChecks.loadError: Could not load the plots measured twice and skipped.

describe.detailsDescription: Prefilled from the experiment. Edit them for this dataset.
describe.authorsDescription: The dataset is cited with its authors in this order. Drag a row to move it.
describe.authorsFinal: Authors cannot be changed after you publish.
describe.orcidInfo_one: {{names}} has not connected an ORCID iD, so is cited by name. Nothing waits for it.
describe.orcidInfo_other: {{names}} have not connected an ORCID iD, so they are cited by name. Nothing waits for them.
describe.byNameHelp: For someone without an openJII account. They are cited by name, with no ORCID iD.
describe.requestInfo_one: {{names}} has not accepted yet, and Freeze waits until they do. To publish sooner, remove them and add them by name.
describe.requestInfo_other: {{names}} have not accepted yet, and Freeze waits until they do. To publish sooner, remove them and add them by name.
describe.limitationsHelp: What a reader should know before reusing this data, such as gaps or conditions it does not cover.
describe.contributorsDescription: Credited in the dataset's record with their part, not in the citation. Measurers who are not authors start here as data collectors.

license.title: Data license
license.description: Prefilled from the study details. The data is published under this license.
license.cc0Detail: No rights reserved. Anyone may reuse the data without giving credit.
license.ccByDetail: Anyone may reuse the data as long as they credit the authors.
license.permanentNote: A license cannot be taken back once the dataset is published.
license.metadataNote: The dataset's metadata is always published under CC0, whatever the data license.
license.rightToPublish: I have the right to publish this data under the chosen license.

access.title: Access
access.description: The title, authors and citation are public as soon as the dataset is published. Choose when its files open.
access.openDetail: Anyone can download the files once the dataset is published.
access.embargoedDetail: The files open by themselves on the date. It can be brought forward later from the Datasets tab, never pushed back.

check.recordDescription: Every dataset follows it. The steps of this flow fill it, so OpenAIRE, the European open-science catalogue, can harvest the dataset.
check.blocked: Freeze waits until every step above is done.

freeze.title: What becomes public
freeze.description: Read this before freezing. Once the dataset is frozen, none of it can be changed.
freeze.accessOpen: Open now. Anyone can download the files.
freeze.accessEmbargoed: The title, authors and citation are public now, and the files open on {{date}}.
freeze.files: The readings, the data dictionary, the layout and the study details

commits.public: The dataset's page is public at once, and anyone can open it without an account.
commits.frozen: Its files never change. A mistake found later becomes a new version.
commits.final: Its license cannot be taken back, and its authors cannot be changed.
commits.experiment: The experiment can then be archived, but never deleted.

freeze.confirmDescription: The dataset becomes public and never changes. The experiment itself stays editable.

page.notFound: This dataset does not exist or is not public.
page.frozenNotice: This is a frozen dataset of a live experiment, so its files never change. The live experiment itself needs an openJII account.

aboutFields.dictionaryValue: Every column, with what it measures

page.embargoDetail: The title, authors and citation are public now. The files are withheld until that date.
page.supersededDetail: Version {{version}} supersedes this one. This version stays as it was published, so citations of it still hold.
page.testDetail: This dataset was deposited in Zenodo's sandbox from a test environment. Its DOI is a test, so no citation is offered.
page.withdrawnFiles: openJII no longer serves its files.
page.withdrawnDoi: Its DOI, {{doi}}, resolves to Zenodo's record.

withdrawnZenodo.requestPrepared: Zenodo's copy stays public until Zenodo acts on the withdrawal request.
withdrawnZenodo.removed: Zenodo has withdrawn its copy and shows its own tombstone.

catalogue.title: Datasets
catalogue.description: Every published dataset on openJII, each a frozen, citable copy of an experiment's data.
